themes.name: Digital Civic Access
themes.rule: Proposals that improve residents' access to city information, online connectivity, forms, service requests, or help using civic services, excluding business licensing.

themes.name: Housing Affordability and Buildings
themes.rule: Proposals that create, convert, regulate, finance, or improve homes and residential buildings, including housing-market transparency.

themes.name: Health and Care Access
themes.rule: Proposals that expand preventive, primary, specialist, mental-health, or in-home care for residents.

themes.name: School and Youth Support
themes.rule: Proposals that improve schools or provide education, meals, enrichment, tutoring, or travel benefits specifically for children and students.

themes.name: Public Transit and Streets
themes.rule: Proposals that improve transit service, cycling infrastructure, or the safety and operation of streets for travel.

themes.name: Community Safety Response
themes.rule: Proposals that prevent crime, improve perceived safety, or shorten emergency-response times through policing, surveillance, lighting, or emergency facilities.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce pollution, waste, emissions, or single-use materials, or monitor environmental conditions and municipal energy use.

themes.name: Neighborhood Green Recreation
themes.rule: Proposals that create or improve local green, outdoor recreation, gardening, playground, or pet spaces, including street-tree planting.

themes.name: Culture and Public Learning
themes.rule: Proposals that expand access to cultural events, libraries, museums, or public art outside the formal school system.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Businesses
themes.rule: Proposals that support workers, local hiring, skills training, independent work, small-business finance, or business regulation and licensing.
